name: Calligraphic Illumination
text:
An ever-shifting series of calligraphic runes scrawls across the pages of this leather-bound book, as if written by an unseen hand. Calligraphic illuminations are sacred to the faith of Irez, Lady of Inscribed Wonder.

Activate—Inscribed Insight f (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect If your last action was to Cast a prepared Spell that creates or manipulates written text or runes, such as Runic Body, the writing briefly forms into words conveying valuable information. Attempt to Recall Knowledge about any one creature or object that you can see with a +2 item bonus to the check.
